svg.title: An UPDATE writes a new row version and keeps the old one
svg.desc: Blank version of the sketch “An UPDATE writes a new row version and keeps the old one” with all labels removed, for drawing from memory. A PostgreSQL heap drawn as page rectangles: two pages of live tuples at 48 MB, then twelve pages after five rounds of full-table updates, ten of them dead, at 284 MB for the same 200 000 live rows. VACUUM marks the dead pages free but the file stays 284 MB; VACUUM FULL rewrites the heap back down to 47 MB at the cost of an ACCESS EXCLUSIVE lock.
svg.text: An UPDATE writes a new row version and keeps the old one
